structure.unit: Production and Sale of Agricultural Products

law.catch_line: Division of Marketing; administration; appointment of Director and assistants; responsibilities

text.section: The Division is hereby established within the Department, and shall be administered under the supervision of the Commissioner by the Director, who shall be qualified for the performance of his duties by training and experience.

The Division shall:
Promote the economical handling, packing, storage, distribution, and sale of agricultural products in the Commonwealth; and
Assist producers and consumers in selling and purchasing agricultural products at a fair and reasonable price.
